sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Type-only build settings for API package
sections.what: Tells the TypeScript compiler to read the src folder and write only type declaration files to dist. It inherits the shared workspace settings.
sections.why: Likely reason: other packages only need the type information, not the runnable code.
sections.watch_out: Changing the rootDir or outDir without updating the package's exports can break imports.

summary: TypeScript settings for the API validation package that tell the compiler to produce only type declaration files.
purpose: Makes the package produce type information that other packages can read, without producing runnable JavaScript.
why: Likely reason: other packages need the type shapes, and the runtime code is handled elsewhere in the build.
how: It inherits the shared base settings from the workspace. It turns on composite and declaration map output, emits declaration files only, writes them to the dist folder, and reads source from the src folder.
inputs: The src folder and the shared base file tsconfig.base.json in the workspace root.
outputs: Declaration files and their maps in the dist folder.
risks: Changes to the base file change this package's behaviour. The base file is not in the packet.
debug: Run the TypeScript compiler on this package and read its errors. Check that the base file path is correct.
